snippet.title: GORAL: Highlander Simulator — Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🏔️ Welcome to the Polish Tatra Mountains in the 1930s!

Discover GORAL: Highlander Simulator, a new simulation game about the challenging life of a traditional mountain shepherd.

🐑 Herd sheep across beautiful mountain pastures.
🐕 Take direct control of your sheepdog.
🧀 Milk sheep and make traditional mountain cheese.
🐺 Protect your flock from wolves and dangerous terrain.
🌩️ Face unpredictable mountain weather.
💰 Earn money and build your own flock!

Start as a young hired shepherd with no sheep of your own. Work hard, survive each season, and build a better future in the mountains.

❤️ Wishlist GORAL: Highlander Simulator on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391960/GORAL_Highlander_Simulator
